usageNotes: Use this to update the comment/description on an existing Proxmox group. The only modifiable field is `comment`; group membership is managed separately via user operations. Requires the `Group.Allocate` privilege on `/access/groups` — the same privilege needed to create or delete groups.

examples.summary: Add a descriptive comment to the 'admins' group

params.comment: Full cluster administrators - break-glass access only

tips: Returns null on success — no response body confirms the change; follow up with get_access_groups_groupid to verify.
To clear a comment, send an empty string for the comment field.
Group membership changes require separate user-update calls (put_access_users_userid), not this endpoint.
